parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Translate $30^\circ$ in the positive $x$-direction then stretch by factor 2 in the $x$-direction, or stretch by factor 2 then translate $60^\circ$; also stretch by factor 4 in the $y$-direction.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Either translate by $\binom{30^\circ}{0}$ or, in the other order, by $\binom{60^\circ}{0}$ — B2,1,0; fully correct B2, two elements correct B1; radians accepted.
Stretch factor 2 in the $x$-direction — B2,1,0; fully correct B2, two elements correct B1.
Stretch factor 4 in the $y$-direction and correct order — B1. Correct order is translation $30^\circ$ then horizontal stretch, or horizontal stretch then translation $60^\circ$; vertical stretch may occur anywhere.
Total: 5

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$4\sin(\frac12x-30^\circ)=2\sqrt2$, so $\sin^{-1}(\sqrt2/2)=45^\circ$ — M1; seen or implied.
$\frac12x-30^\circ=45^\circ$ or $135^\circ$, hence $x=2(45+30)$ or $2(135+30)$ — M1; M marks independent.
$x=150^\circ$, $330^\circ$ — A1; both exact; condone $5\pi/6$, $11\pi/6$; extra solutions in interval A0, ignore outside interval.
Total: 3
